Specialization.Name: Instructor (reSpecialized)
Specialization.Description: [H4]Instructor (reSpecialized)[h4] [B]INSTRUCTOR—LISTEN UP MAGGOTS[b][BR] [B]At a Glance[b][BR] The Instructor is the small L squad leader, focused on the immediate group they are in charge of: Their training, their war-fighting, and their safety.[BR] The instructor has many ways to do so: The hard Ass, the inspiring leader, or the protective mentor. All are valid, because some trainees need some tough love, and a good ass kicking[BR] [B]All-in or Hybrid?[b][BR] 4-Way Hybrid: ¼ Leadership ¼ Coercion ¼ Teaching ¼ Protecting[BR] [B]What Should it be the Best At?[b][BR] Military Small Squad Leadership[BR] Teaching and Training[BR] [B]What should it be just “good” at?[b][BR] Armed Conflict[BR] Protecting Allies[BR] Being Imposing[BR] [B]Specs for Comparison / Inspiration[b][BR] [I]Marshal[i](The marshall is more about subdual than “Leadership” specifically, but they share the Leadership/Coercion space)[BR] [I]Warden[i](The Warden is a defensive coercion character, which is pretty close. Obviously the Warden is more of a martial artist)[BR] [I]Sepratist Commander[i](Coercion as Leadership is their core overlap)[BR] [I]Warden[i](The teacher is more all-in on teaching and sharing skills and talents. The Instructor is more about being a Force-Multiplier in combat, but they share a similar core.)[BR] [B]Media Touchstones[b][BR] ARC Trooper CT-7567 “Rex”(Clone Wars, Rebels)[BR] CT-9901 “Hunter” (The Bad Batch)[BR] Vel Sartha (Andor Season 2)[BR] “Gunny” Highway (Heartbreak Ridge)[BR] Gunnery Sergeant Hartman (Full Metal Jacket)[BR] Sgt.
